step.label: Retrieve Customer Account and Order Context
step.description: Load customer accounts and associated orders to establish the baseline scope for compliance evaluation.
step.useCase: A compliance officer needs to identify which customers and orders are subject to material change impact assessment.

step.label: Validate Bill of Materials Compliance
step.description: Verify that all product components in the bill of materials meet current regulatory and engineering standards.
step.useCase: An engineering team must confirm that product specifications align with approved material lists before proceeding to production.

step.label: Assess Hazardous Substance Restrictions
step.description: Confirm that product materials and components comply with hazardous substance regulations and customer-specific restrictions.
step.useCase: A marketing-compliance specialist needs assurance that no restricted or regulated substances are present in customer orders.

step.label: Analyze Material Change Readiness and Workforce Impact
step.description: Evaluate engineering changes and material modifications to determine organizational readiness and required workforce adjustments.
step.useCase: HR leadership requires impact projections for staffing, training, and organizational restructuring tied to material and product changes.

step.label: Assess Employee Safety Performance and Risk Profile
step.description: Review workforce safety trends and performance metrics to identify potential risks associated with production changes.
step.useCase: A safety manager needs to understand whether current workforce safety metrics support transition to revised production processes.

step.label: Coordinate Performance Review Cycle Adjustments
step.description: Align employee performance reviews with competency requirements for new products and process methodologies.
step.useCase: An HR business partner must synchronize performance evaluation timelines and competency assessments with the material change initiative.

step.label: Evaluate Production Quality and Yield Impact
step.description: Analyze historical quality and yield data to project production performance under new material and process conditions.
step.useCase: A manufacturing manager needs yield forecasts and quality baselines to validate that new materials will meet production targets.

step.label: Retrieve Vendor and Campaign Account Information
step.description: Consolidate vendor capabilities and campaign-linked customer accounts to finalize compliance and readiness approvals.
step.useCase: A procurement lead must verify vendor capacity and campaign alignment before authorizing material change and order fulfillment.
